text_markup: Once the Runner leaves the innermost position protecting a server, they no longer have a position. This occurs at {ref:step_move_position} of the Movement Phase. However, abilities can still move the Runner to a position later in that phase.
text_plain: Once the Runner leaves the innermost position protecting a server, they no longer have a position. This occurs at step 6.9.4d of the Movement Phase. However, abilities can still move the Runner to a position later in that phase.
